title: I like it overall, but there are manufacturing defects
text:
I like it overall, but there are manufacturing defects. I haven't sent feedback to the seller mostly because I don't want to waste a lot of money and time sending the chair back to get another. Mine was fairly good, but when I went to put the right arm rest on I found that the 4 holes for the screws had not been tapped. I can't get the screws installed, which means that my version of this chair has no right arm rest.

Other than that its very comfortable and as I am used to a kneeling chair with no arm rests, I've decided to keep it and use it without.

But I can't give it 4 or 5 stars considering the poor quality control that allowed a chair to be shipped with holes that were untapped.
